Lock note (watchdog flagged the 35B serve as off-lock at 17:33): the 35B legs were started under `lockf -k /tmp/kapitsa-gpu.lock` (log line 'lock held: 35B pair' 17:30:51). At 17:31 my own `pkill -f` self-test killed the wrapper and its lockf (k436-q436d exit 143); the orphaned legs scripts (pids 4390/4393, kapitsa serve child pid 27073 under 4393) kept running to LEGSDONE 17:34:12. The lock was therefore held, if at all, only through the fd inherited from the killed lockf. Evidence is indirect: #411's line (blocked at lockf) logged 'server ready' at 17:34:15, three seconds after LEGSDONE, and its serve did not overlap the legs. I did NOT capture `lsof /tmp/kapitsa-gpu.lock` during the legs, so the holder is unproven.
